split_isolation: one report contains exactly one dataset_role

configuration.repeatability_projection: all aggregate model outputs excluding runtime-only metrics

scoring_policy.aggregation: Pool labeled observations and reacquisition events within each dataset_role while also reporting every clip; never tune or set thresholds per clip.
scoring_policy.underpowered_metric_behavior: Return null with a reason and fail the overall gate closed.
scoring_policy.gaze_metric_behavior: Do not score gaze because the corpus has no independently labeled contact/away truth.
scoring_policy.claim_boundary: These are pre-registered engineering gates for this fifteen-clip iteration-2 scenario corpus, not population accuracy, gaze accuracy, identity recognition, or model-training evidence. Iteration-1 holdout failure remains disclosed.

annotation_evidence: single-curator coarse observed-state intervals; not independently adjudicated accuracy

underpowered_reasons.gaze_accuracy: natural multi-camera presentation clips have no reliable camera-contact ground truth
